name: Lightward is a native flat duration modifier on Blessing of Purity (#3177)
contract: Spell.dbc 800233 ("Lightward", SpellFamilyName 33, Passive) effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), EffectBasePoints 1999 (amount 2000, i.e. 2000 ms = 2 sec), and EffectSpellClassMask word 1 = 512, which a repository-wide Spell.dbc scan for family-33 spells shows matches exactly one spell: 680889 'Blessing of Purity'. Player::ApplySpellMod's SPELLMOD_DURATION branch (Player.cpp:10219, the CASTING_TIME/DURATION special case) computes basevalue = (basevalue+totalflat)*totalmul, so base 0 with a single +2000 flat modifier and no pct modifier reads back exactly 2000 — the tooltip's '+2 sec' precisely. This is a fully generic native pipeline; no server script exists or is needed. (Effect 1 of 800233 carries a different class mask, word 3 = 2048, matching Sunshine/Final Vows — an unrelated modifier bundled into the same passive, out of scope for this issue and noted separately.)

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Sanity: no duration modifier on Blessing of Purity before learning
Blessing of Purity's duration is increased by exactly 2000 ms
An unrelated family-33 spell (Radiant Cascade) keeps its normal duration
